title: bardolier build output
description: Base images considered by `bardolier build`. cli-spec.md §6 (Images), §4.3.

uid.description: Host UID passed as a build arg.

gid.description: Host GID passed as a build arg.

reason.description: Why the image is unavailable; absent on success.

platform.description: Platform the image is pinned to (e.g. linux/amd64); absent when it builds for the host's own architecture.

claudeCodeVersion.description: The Claude Code version passed to this build — `latest` by default, or the exact X.Y.Z --claude-code-version asked for. Present whenever status is built; absent for unavailable.
